extraction_notes: Main-text measured ammonia-synthesis performance data were present in Figure 1 only. Figures 2–7 are characterization/mechanistic figures and were skipped. Literature/equilibrium-limit curves in Figure 1 were not extracted. In Figure 1a, the 650 °C-prereduced series did not show an unambiguous 450 °C point in the page image; it was skipped rather than assigned uncertainly. NH3-yield values were read from the right axis where visible (Figures 1a and 1c) and stored as outlet_nh3 with unit '% NH3-yield'.
